chief_complaint: Shortness of breath and fatigue for the past week, worse with exertion.
doctor_notes: Patient presents with classic symptoms of CHF exacerbation. Elevated BNP confirms diagnosis. Blood pressure is elevated. Will initiate diuretic and adjust current antihypertensives. Monitor fluid status closely. Discussed low-sodium diet with patient.

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: Doctor, I've been feeling so tired and I can barely catch my breath these last few days. Even walking to the kitchen is a struggle.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: I understand, Eleanor. I've reviewed your vital signs and lab work. Your BNP is quite elevated, which suggests fluid in your lungs, consistent with heart failure worsening.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: We need to manage it promptly. I'm going to increase your Lasix and adjust your blood pressure medication. We'll also need to monitor your weight daily and follow a low-salt diet. Do you have any questions about that?

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: No, Doctor. I'll do whatever it takes. Thank you.
